name: 32951 · Melbourne Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 32951 (Melbourne Bch) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32951 (Melbourne Bch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32951 (Melbourne Bch) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
